en.headline: Task force dismantles second bid-rigging group involving 15 estates
en.dek: The joint task force said it arrested 33 people and blocked two contracts worth about HK$7.6 million after uncovering deals totalling more than HK$130 million.
body: The joint task force on building maintenance bid-rigging said on Monday it had dismantled a second group involving 15 housing estates or residential buildings and engineering contracts worth more than HK$130 million.

Security Secretary Chris Tang told a press conference that 33 people were arrested, including directors and staff of contractors and engineering firms as well as members of owners’ corporations. Some had triad backgrounds. The group was accused of forging documents, conspiracy to defraud and offering benefits to agents.

The task force said it had blocked two contracts valued at about HK$7.6 million. Methods described included infiltrating owners’ corporations, colluding on tenders and using overlapping company interests to conceal links.

zh.headline: 特遣隊再瓦解圍標集團 涉15屋苑工程逾1.3億
zh.dek: 聯合特遣隊表示已拘捕33人，並阻止兩份約760萬元合約，涉案工程合約總額超過1.3億元。
body: 打擊樓宇維修工程圍標聯合特遣隊周一表示，已瓦解另一圍標集團，涉及15個屋苑或住宅大廈，工程合約總額超過1.3億元。
保安局局長鄧炳強在記者會上表示，行動拘捕33人，包括承建商及工程公司的董事和職員，以及業主立案法團成員，部分有黑社會背景。被捕人士涉偽造文書、串謀詐騙及串謀向代理人提供利益。
特遣隊指已成功阻止兩份約值760萬元的合約。手法包括滲透法團、操控招標及透過公司交叉利益掩飾關係。
